_comment: Authored dishes are the primary pool. Each carries: section, biomes (where it's native, OR 'any'), seasons (OR 'all-seasons'), optional tier_min/tier_max (inn-tier gating), cost (1-5), and tags (cultural: peasant/common/refined/noble; cuisine: mediterranean/nordic; plus exotic and peculiar). Mains carry contains ('meat' or 'fish'); omit it for meatless mains. Optional 'flavor' is a short description the LLM polish layer can use verbatim; optional '_comment' is an authoring note. Imports are modeled by biome trade-distance plus the 'exotic' tag (see docs/DESIGN.md), not per-dish flags.

dishes.name: Spiced wine
dishes.flavor: Sweet, warm and infused with cinnamon, ginger and clove.

dishes.name: Spinach pie with chervil and eggs
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Mountain-style rat skewer with Bulgan chard
Porridge stew
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Barley, cucumber and pork kidney soup
Poached egg and garlic bacon soup
Herring strips with onion and cucumber
Barbarian meatballs
dishes.flavor: Minced beef, flattened, grilled over open fire.

dishes.name: Fresh peas with parsley and mint
Red snapper and cream of pumpkin soup
Skewered mole, onion and white radish
Reindeer quarters with pomegranate
dishes.flavor: Northern game meets southern trade.

dishes.name: May eggs
dishes.flavor: poached eggs in butter sauce

dishes.name: Hake with garlic and almond sauce
Chickpea stew
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Mushroom and vegetable stew
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Halibut fillet with ginger and garlic
Trout casserole with onions and turnips
Roast chicken with orange juice glaze
Cod with butter and fennel seeds
Chicken in a cream and wine sauce
Seal fat porridge
dishes.flavor: Oats boiled grey in blubber. Sticks to the ribs and the spoon.

dishes.name: Lichen bread
dishes.flavor: Scraped from rock, pounded with rye. Chewed slow.

dishes.name: Fermented reindeer soup
dishes.flavor: Old meat, older broth. The smell does the work.

dishes.name: Cave bear stew
dishes.flavor: Three days in a covered pot. The fat could grease a wheel.

dishes.name: Forest roots in pork fat
dishes.flavor: What the woods gave and what the pig left behind.

dishes.name: Warmed birch sap
dishes.flavor: Faintly sweet. Mostly water.

dishes.name: Black bread and honey
dishes.flavor: Yesterday's loaf, a smear of comb. Wax coats the teeth.

dishes.name: Whale skin crisps with cloudberries
dishes.flavor: Skin cut thin and fried hard. A thumb of yellow pickle on the side.

dishes.name: Spit-roasted albatross
dishes.flavor: A bird the size of a child. Killing one brings storms. They eat them anyway.

dishes.name: Smoked elk shoulder with watercress
dishes.flavor: A fortnight over alder smoke. The greens are a courtesy.

dishes.name: Blood pudding with birch syrup
dishes.flavor: Blood, oats, suet, bound in gut. Sweetened at the plate.

dishes.name: Fermented trout in birch bark
dishes.flavor: Six weeks buried. Pulled apart with the fingers.

dishes.name: Reindeer tartare with fern ash and mint
dishes.flavor: Scraped fine with a knife. Black ash, green herb.

dishes.name: Honey custard with cured petals
dishes.flavor: Scattered with wild rose dried in salt. A dish for people who have never been hungry.

dishes.name: Pine needle tea
dishes.flavor: Said to fend off the cough.

dishes.name: Curds with bilberry
dishes.flavor: Strained in linen. Berries crushed on top with the back of a spoon.

dishes.name: Megaceront ribs in pine and thyme
dishes.flavor: One rib feeds three. Carved at table.

dishes.name: Raw whale, salt and dill
dishes.flavor: Loin sliced paper-thin. Salt and dill on cold stone.

dishes.name: Auroch steak with red butter and coriander
dishes.flavor: Seared hard. Butter the colour of dried blood.

dishes.name: Cured reindeer heart
dishes.flavor: Salted, hung through winter. Sliced translucent.

dishes.name: Barley cake with birch syrup
dishes.flavor: Soaked in cream at the table, poured over by the kitchen girl.

dishes.name: The Mariner's Cup
dishes.flavor: Shark blood warmed with honey and spirit. Drunk from a horn.

dishes.name: Stuffed albatross with fermented berries
dishes.flavor: Boned whole, packed with pork, mint and roots. The berries do what wine cannot.

dishes.name: Whale loin in black butter
dishes.flavor: Seared rare. Butter cooked till it smokes. The plate arrives silent.

dishes.name: Crowberry cordial on ice
dishes.flavor: Pressed and steeped in spirit. Served over lake ice, dark as a hoofprint.

dishes.name: Rabbit pie with sea herbs
dishes.flavor: Wild rabbit baked under a crust of samphire and thyme.

dishes.name: Venison loin in salt-fish sauce
dishes.flavor: An old coastal kitchen trick: fermented anchovy darkens the gravy.

dishes.name: Wild boar braised in juniper and cider
Salt cod stew with winter roots
dishes.flavor: The cod travels in barrels. The roots are whatever the cellar still has.

dishes.name: Marinated entrails of large fish
dishes.flavor: The exact species is left to one's imagination.

dishes.name: Salmon smoked in dill with dark rye bread
dishes.flavor: Cold-smoked over alder. The rye is heavy enough to stand under it.

dishes.name: Scallops in shells with garlic and herbs
dishes.flavor: Served on the half-shell, butter pooling at the base.

dishes.name: Fin stew
dishes.flavor: Trimmings the fishmonger sets aside. Simmered down to gelatin.

dishes.name: Serving of krill
dishes.flavor: A pink heap, eaten by the spoonful with vinegar.

dishes.name: Sautéed cod tongues
dishes.flavor: Pulled at the dock for a copper a sack. Crisped in butter.

dishes.name: Pickled whale blubber
dishes.flavor: Cubes the colour of old wax. Sour brine masks the fat.

dishes.name: Stuffed fish stomach
dishes.flavor: Packed with bread, herbs and what didn't sell. Sewn shut and poached.

dishes.name: Boar head broth
dishes.flavor: The skull boiled long. The marrow does the seasoning.

dishes.name: Chopped ham
dishes.flavor: Hacked from the leg with a cleaver. No knife required to eat it.

dishes.name: Offal and leek pie
dishes.flavor: Heart, lung, kidney leftovers under a hard crust.

dishes.name: Sheep liver sausage
dishes.flavor: Coarse-ground, dark, iron-bitter.

dishes.name: Rye and ale porridge
dishes.flavor: Rye boiled in flat ale. Eaten hot to keep the chill out.
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Frog and snail pot
dishes.flavor: Both gathered from the same wet stones. Stewed with garlic and vinegar.

dishes.name: Hare stew with breadcrumbs and mushrooms
dishes.flavor: The crumbs thicken what the cellar mushrooms cannot.

dishes.name: Day old bread with lard
dishes.flavor: Rubbed with a clove of garlic. Salted heavy.

dishes.name: Sheep head jelly
dishes.flavor: Set in its own broth. Quivers when the table is bumped.

dishes.name: Chicken stock with leeks and prunes
dishes.flavor: An old hen simmered with leeks and dried plums until both fall apart.

dishes.name: Toast with potato and pork bits
dishes.flavor: Crusts piled with mashed root and crackling scraps.

dishes.name: Cellar pottage with flatbread
dishes.flavor: Whatever the cellar gives, slow-boiled. Bread used as spoon.
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Windfall apples
dishes.flavor: Bruised, fly-marked, nearly free.

dishes.name: Oat porridge with salt
dishes.flavor: Salt is the only seasoning the kitchen gives away.
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Sour ram testicles pickled in whey
dishes.flavor: Sliced cold. Not for the squeamish.

dishes.name: Serving of crawfish
dishes.flavor: Boiled red in salted river water. Piled high, peeled at the table.

dishes.name: Roasted beetle grubs
dishes.flavor: Skewered like beads. Burst sweet between the teeth.

dishes.name: Leaf wrapped lizard
dishes.flavor: Whole, gutted, packed in fig leaves under coals.

dishes.name: Maize flour porridge
dishes.flavor: Yellow, thick, eaten with a wooden paddle.
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Bean stew with coriander and palm oil
dishes.flavor: Red oil rises to the surface. Coriander stems thrown in whole.
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Sumac chicken with bulgur
dishes.flavor: Grain steamed in the bird's own fat.

dishes.name: Orchard cider
dishes.flavor: Pressed in late summer. The autumn batch runs darker and bites sharper.

dishes.name: Healer's botanical
dishes.flavor: A tincture, really. The innkeep pours it slow and says nothing.

dishes.name: Mulled cider
dishes.flavor: Warmed with clove and peel. Smells like the end of the harvest.

dishes.name: Honey wine
dishes.flavor: Still fermenting, some say. Tastes like it.

dishes.name: Barley brown stout
dishes.flavor: Roasted barley, slow ferment. Pours brown, finishes bitter.

dishes.name: Sumac water
dishes.flavor: Red from the berry, tart, served cool.

dishes.name: Date wine
dishes.flavor: More food than drink by some accounts.

dishes.name: Mint leaves infusion
dishes.flavor: Provided free to those with nothing.

dishes.name: Fig sherbet over shaved ice
dishes.flavor: Crushed figs over ice shaved from the cold-room. Eaten with a small spoon.

dishes.name: Anise spirit
dishes.flavor: Clear and sharp. Turns white in water.

dishes.name: Rosewater cordial
dishes.flavor: Syrup of rose, diluted and chilled. More for show than thirst.

dishes.name: Pinebud spirit
dishes.flavor: Distilled in monastery cellars from the first buds. One cup is enough.

dishes.name: Cranberry brandy
dishes.flavor: Pressed and twice-distilled. Pours red, finishes dry.

dishes.name: Malt aquavit
dishes.flavor: Rough and reliable.

dishes.name: Peat-smoked bitter
dishes.flavor: Cask ale, peated malt. Tastes of the hearth it was brewed beside.

dishes.name: Oyster stout
dishes.flavor: Brewed with liquor from the shucking barrel. Black, briny, thick.

dishes.name: Brine and citrus cordial
dishes.flavor: Salt-rim optional.

dishes.name: Samphire liquor
dishes.flavor: Salt-marsh herb spirit. Smells of low tide.

dishes.name: Sour whey spirit
dishes.flavor: What's left after the cheese is made, fermented and distilled.

dishes.name: Small thaw beer
dishes.flavor: Light and slightly sour. Made for the brief warm. Does not keep.

dishes.name: Ice cellar ale
dishes.flavor: Kept in permafrost pits. Summer makes it drinkable.

dishes.name: Saffron and marrow custard
dishes.flavor: Set in small ramekins. Bright yellow, faintly mineral.

dishes.name: Chicken simmered in almond milk
dishes.flavor: Pale, fragrant, faintly sweet. Eaten by the devout in lent.

dishes.name: Duck glazed with honey and mustard
Cabbage leaves stuffed with minced pork
Baked onions filled with egg and breadcrumbs
Gourds filled with melted cheese
dishes._comment: intentionally meatless

dishes.name: Stewed apples and pears in red wine
Spiced wine jelly with gold leaf
dishes.flavor: Trembling, garnet, dusted with edible gold. A talking-point dessert.

dishes.name: Pounded wheat and lamb porridge
dishes.flavor: Cheap, filling, and here again tomorrow. The fat is the celebration.
dishes._comment: harisa; cookshop staple sold from stalls (Zaouali pp. 20, 42; al-Warraq)

dishes.name: Broth-sopped flatbread with mutton
dishes.flavor: What the poor eat when there is broth. Bread does the drowning.
dishes._comment: tharid; the definitional Arab dish (Zaouali no. 10 [S]; Ibn Razin's crumbing method no. 11 note)

dishes.name: Bread sop with desert truffles
dishes.flavor: Truffles the spring rains bury for whoever digs first and luckiest.
dishes._comment: shashiyyat Ibn al-Rafi (Zaouali no. 11 [R]); desert truffles are a real post-rain arid delicacy

dishes.name: Lentils and rice with browned onions
dishes.flavor: Lentils again. The dark onions on top are a kindness, or a lie.
dishes._comment: mujaddara (Zaouali p. 42); meatless

dishes.name: Whole-wheat pottage in meat broth
dishes._comment: qamhiyya (Zaouali no. 87 [W])

dishes.name: Noodles in chicken broth
dishes._comment: itriya / nabatiyya (Zaouali nos. 89-97 [R][K][S])

dishes.name: Couscous with mutton and vegetables
dishes._comment: classic couscous (Zaouali no. 98 [R])

dishes.name: Couscous with walnuts
dishes._comment: couscous with walnuts (Zaouali no. 99 [R]); meatless

dishes.name: Desert spit-roast lamb
dishes.flavor: Turned in the open and carved fast, before the flies are asked.
dishes._comment: the Bedouin-specialty roast in the Wusla kebab section (Scents and Flavors ch. 6)

dishes.name: Skewered lamb with sumac crumbs
dishes._comment: Egyptian kebabs + sumac crumb stuffing (Scents and Flavors ch. 6)

dishes.name: Lamb braised in vinegar and date syrup
dishes.flavor: The sour braise the old poets bragged about. Believe half of it.
dishes._comment: sikbaj, the most storied dish of the tradition (Zaouali no. 15 note)

dishes.name: Meatballs and eggplant in sour broth
dishes._comment: sikbaj with eggplant (Zaouali no. 15 [K]); kibritiyya variant no. 42 [W]

dishes.name: Sweet-sour chicken with almonds and saffron
dishes.flavor: Pale with almond, gilt with saffron; a dish dressed for company.
dishes._comment: zirbaj / zirbajiyya (Zaouali nos. 19 [W], 20 [R])

dishes.name: Lamb stewed with fresh dates
dishes.flavor: Lamb and dates cooked down to amber, and very nearly to poetry.
dishes._comment: rutabiyya (Zaouali no. 26 [W]); rutab = fresh-ripe dates, hence autumn

dishes.name: Meatballs in pomegranate juice
dishes.flavor: Sweet, then sharp: the flattery of a practised courtier.
dishes._comment: rummaniyya (Zaouali no. 16 [K])

dishes.name: Meatballs in silky stewed greens
dishes.flavor: Glossy, clinging, and fully intending to stain your good sleeve.
dishes._comment: mulukhiyya (Zaouali no. 47 [K]; meatless variant no. 48); also Scents and Flavors ch. 6

dishes.name: Fried eggplant with spiced lamb
dishes.flavor: Named for a queen, eaten by everyone. She would not have minded.
dishes._comment: buraniyya, first of the eight eggplant dishes (Scents and Flavors ch. 6); named for Buran, bride of al-Ma'mun

dishes.name: Eggplant stuffed with minced lamb
dishes._comment: stuffed eggplant, sixth of the eight types (Scents and Flavors ch. 6; Zaouali no. 44 [W])

dishes.name: Buttered rice with lamb and chickpeas
dishes._comment: mufalfal rice (Zaouali no. 105 [W])

dishes.name: Lamb in warm yogurt sauce
dishes._comment: labaniyya (Zaouali no. 39 [W])

dishes.name: Fish stewed with lemon
dishes._comment: limuniyya (Zaouali no. 50 [K])

dishes.name: Fried pastries stuffed with spiced lamb
dishes.flavor: Fried scalding and eaten sooner. Patience is punished here.
dishes._comment: sanbusak, four recipes (Scents and Flavors ch. 6-7)

dishes.name: Grilled liver sausages
dishes.flavor: Liver, coals, and salt. It asks nothing and answers less.
dishes._comment: liver sausages in the manner of Caliph al-Mu'tamid (Zaouali no. 32 [S])

dishes.name: Chickpea puree with cinnamon and ginger
dishes._comment: hummus ancestor (Zaouali no. 6 [K]); meatless

dishes.name: Fava beans in sour herb sauce
dishes._comment: Zaouali no. 7 [K]; meatless

dishes.name: Eggplant puree with yogurt
dishes._comment: baba ghanoush ancestor (Zaouali no. 8 [K]); meatless

dishes.name: Carrots and leeks in sesame paste
dishes._comment: Zaouali no. 9 [K]; meatless

dishes.name: Cold chicken in green herb dressing
dishes.flavor: Served cold and green, from a royal book long since lost.
dishes._comment: barida from the lost book of al-Ma'mun (Zaouali no. 1 [S])

dishes.name: Olives marinated with thyme
dishes._comment: Zaouali no. 5 [S]; meatless

dishes.name: Turnip pickles
dishes._comment: mukhallalat: nine turnip pickle variants open Scents and Flavors ch. 8; meatless

dishes.name: Salt-preserved lemons
dishes._comment: salted lemons, three variations (Scents and Flavors ch. 8); meatless

dishes.name: Vinegar-pickled onions
dishes.flavor: Sharp enough to settle an argument, or start a better one.
dishes._comment: pickled onions, three variations (Scents and Flavors ch. 8); meatless

dishes.name: Capers cured with sumac
dishes._comment: caper pickles, several kinds (Scents and Flavors ch. 8); meatless

dishes.name: Pickled baby eggplants stuffed with walnut
dishes._comment: stuffed eggplant pickles (Scents and Flavors ch. 8); makdous ancestor; meatless

dishes.name: Pickled roses
dishes.flavor: Whole roses drowned in sweet vinegar. A perfume you are meant to eat.
dishes._comment: pickled roses, sixteenth pickle type (Scents and Flavors ch. 8); meatless

dishes.name: Village fish paste
dishes.flavor: No sea within a month's ride. It insists otherwise.
dishes._comment: mock fish paste, 'village fish paste', seventeenth pickle type (Scents and Flavors ch. 8); meatless

dishes.name: Aged crock condiment
dishes.flavor: Older than the pot it sits in, and prouder of its smell.
dishes._comment: kamakh, incl. kamakh with tarragon (Zaouali no. 139 [K]); Zaouali compares the flavor family to blue cheese

dishes.name: Salted locust relish
dishes.flavor: The famine sent them. Some kept eating after it left.
dishes._comment: locust sahna (Zaouali no. 140 [S]); historically attested, pairs with the existing beetle-grub entry

dishes.name: Honeyed dates
dishes.flavor: Dates in warm honey: the desert's entire notion of luxury.
dishes._comment: honeyed dates (Scents and Flavors ch. 7 supplement)

dishes.name: Dates stuffed with almonds
dishes.flavor: Every stone traded for an almond: a small, forgivable swindle.
dishes._comment: stuffed dates (Scents and Flavors ch. 7 supplement)

dishes.name: Date halwa with pistachios
dishes.flavor: Cut in slabs, dense and dark as a moneylender's affection.
dishes._comment: halwa' tamriyyah (Scents and Flavors ch. 7, 7.58)

dishes.name: Semolina pudding in clarified butter
dishes.flavor: Named for a prince; it leaves the pan in one soft, contented sigh.
dishes._comment: ma'muniyya, three recipes (Scents and Flavors ch. 7); named for Caliph al-Ma'mun

dishes.name: Lattice fritters in syrup
dishes.flavor: Festival gold that shatters loudly enough to draw a crowd.
dishes._comment: zulabiyya mushabbaka (Zaouali no. 120 [S]); festival fritter

dishes.name: Judge's morsels
dishes.flavor: The judge ate them by the plateful. The name is his sentence.
dishes._comment: luqam al-qadi (Scents and Flavors ch. 7, 7.82); the name is the historical one

dishes.name: Traveler's crumb sweet
dishes.flavor: Keeps for weeks in a saddlebag. That is the kindest thing about it.
dishes._comment: basisa and qawut (Scents and Flavors ch. 7, 7.92 and 7.94); caravanserai travel food

dishes.name: Candied citron peel
dishes.flavor: Bitter rind flattered by sugar until it glints like a jewel.
dishes._comment: candied citron peels (Zaouali no. 125 [K])

dishes.name: Quince and honey-vinegar sherbet
dishes.flavor: Honey and vinegar make their peace in a cup of cold water.
dishes._comment: quince sikanjubin (Zaouali no. 123 [K]); the sekanjabin/oxymel family

dishes.name: Thick sweet grain brew
dishes.flavor: Ladled cloudy from a street crock. Faintly fizzing, faintly suspect.
dishes._comment: Yemeni subiyyah (Scents and Flavors ch. 2, 2.1); barely fermented, sold as street drink

dishes.name: Dried apricot cordial
dishes.flavor: Pressed amber and sweet-kerneled: bottled sunlight, more or less.
dishes._comment: marinated sweet-kerneled apricot drink (Scents and Flavors ch. 2)

dishes.name: Pressed pomegranate draught
dishes._comment: reconstituted pomegranate and prepared pomegranate seeds (Scents and Flavors ch. 2)

dishes.name: Lemon-sugar sherbet
dishes.flavor: Sugar and lemon on cold water: summer, for those who can afford it.
dishes._comment: sugar and lemon drink (Scents and Flavors ch. 2); sugar pricing justifies tier_min 2
